baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative prepositional phrase بأي ذنب at word 2 governs the feminine passive قتلت at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction demands a culpable cause proportionate to an irreversible killing while leaving the killer unvoiced. The alleged offense is placed under examination rather than simply asserted.

activation_trace.role: Sin and culpable consequence supply the alleged legal cause that the interrogative forces to be named and tested.
Putting a life to death supplies the terminal harm against which any alleged cause must be weighed.

changed_reading.before: A bare report that a female was killed.
changed_reading.after: A causal indictment that tests whether any culpable act can bear the weight of the killing while the agent remains grammatically suppressed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same two focus roots permit ذنب to trail behind an act and قتل to include making someone liable or exposed to death.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tail image turns guilt from a static label into something that follows, while exposure-to-killing moves attention upstream from the final blow. Together they open a causal chain of attachment, vulnerability, and death.

activation_trace.role: A tail or trailing end supplies the image of a consequence or status made to follow the victim.
Exposing someone to being killed supplies the upstream act of making the victim killable, not only the completed death.

changed_reading.before: The verse isolates one completed homicide and asks for its reason.
changed_reading.after: The verse also audits the process by which an attached consequence or imposed status was made to trail into lethal exposure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذنب at word 2 can image rear-ranked followers, and قتل at word 3 can image subduing until force is softened.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch pair constructs a social mechanism in which dependent or rear-ranked people are first reduced and disciplined, then subjected to terminal violence. The question probes whether low rank itself was converted into culpability.

activation_trace.role: Followers figured as tails supply the victim's imposed dependent and socially rear-ranked position.
Subduing or training until force is softened supplies the disciplinary process preceding or accompanying lethal domination.

changed_reading.before: An individual is killed for an unspecified personal offense.
changed_reading.after: A dependent is killed through a hierarchy that first makes her low status look like guilt and her subjugation look normal.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative بأي selects a ذنب whose inventory includes an allotted portion, specifically including a share of punishment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can ask not only what offense caused death but what portion of punishment was assigned to the victim and by what distributive rule. Killing becomes the allocated outcome under audit.

activation_trace.role: An allotted share, including a share of punishment, supplies the distributive object selected and challenged by بأي.
Actual killing supplies the fatal portion whose assignment requires justification.

changed_reading.before: The question seeks an offense that causally preceded death.
changed_reading.after: The question audits how death was allotted as the victim's supposed share and whether that distribution can be justified.

context_deltas.mechanism: A life-bearing self is paired among other selves and then becomes the feminine subject of asking. This reverses the focus-only image of a rear-ranked dependent: the person reduced to an object of killing is restored as the addressee around whom the proceeding turns.

activation_trace.role: Rear-ranked followers name the social reduction that the surrounding sequence reverses.
Literal killing keeps the restored witness identity anchored to the focus harm rather than becoming a general theme of dignity.
The self by which life exists supplies full living personhood before the focus names the death.
Making one thing a companion to another places the victim within a relational ordering of selves rather than at society's tail.
Asking and requesting supply the procedural act that gives the following بأي ذنب its witness-facing force.

structural_cues: 81:8 supplies the explicit feminine victim noun under missing-inventory root و ء د; it is used only to resolve the subject of the feminine passives.
81:8 سئلت and 81:9 قتلت form an ask-then-kill passive pair with the same feminine singular referent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a life-bearing self, pairing, and asking; I infer that the sequence grants the silenced victim witness standing and reverses her tail-like social rank. A live alternative is that the sequence marks eschatological grouping without implying procedural standing.

changed_reading.before: A socially dependent victim remains only the grammatical object of a remembered death.
changed_reading.after: The dependent is restored as a full self and central addressee, so the question reorganizes the hearing around her rather than around the status that devalued her.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passive killing suppresses its agent, but the context supplies covert extraction, removal of a covering, and concealment in a grave. These images turn agent suppression into part of the crime's concealment and make the question an operation that reverses that concealment.

activation_trace.role: A trailing end supplies the recoverable trace by which a concealed causal chain can be followed backward.
Making someone exposed or liable to killing supplies the hidden enabling stage behind the agentless completed passive.
The non-dominant split branch of covert extraction supplies a strange but exact image for removal carried out out of sight.
Removing a cover and exposing what was hidden supplies the reversal applied to the suppressed human agency.
Concealing someone in a grave supplies the material endpoint of hidden death that the question brings back into view.

structural_cues: The focus's feminine passive names the death but omits the killer.
The repeated passive sequence around 81:8-13 first hides agents grammatically and then repeatedly exposes, opens, or ignites what had been closed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covert extraction, uncovering, grave-concealment, and exposure to killing; I infer a concealed liability pipeline whose omitted agent the question forces into view. Alternatively, the branch images may remain local to their separate context ayat and the passive may have no concealment function.

changed_reading.before: The passive merely reports a killing without naming its agent.
changed_reading.after: The missing agent becomes a forensic absence: the question follows the crime's tail through covert exposure and burial until concealed responsibility is publicly recoverable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Written pages are opened and spread, what each self has brought becomes known and present, and قتل itself has a branch of complete factual mastery. The focus question therefore need not seek missing information; it can expose that the killing is settled while the alleged culpable cause is what fails evidentiary testing.

activation_trace.role: Culpable offense supplies the proposition to be tested against the opened record.
Complete mastery of a fact gives the literal killing a secondary resonance of a case known beyond factual dispute.
A written page supplies the durable evidentiary surface immediately following the question.
Writing or a published book supplies the act of making the record accessible rather than withholding it.
Disclosure to the knower supplies epistemic certainty rather than an unanswered request for facts.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness supply the evidentiary presentation of what was done.

structural_cues: The focus is followed immediately by opened pages and later by a self knowing what it brought forward.
The focus question receives no stated offense as an answer, leaving the alleged cause exposed as the unstable term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a written page, publication, disclosure, presence, and complete factual mastery; I infer a forensic record in which the question tests a claim rather than solicits unknown evidence. Alternatively, the opened records may concern each self separately and need not function as this victim's case file.

changed_reading.before: The victim is asked to provide information about why she died.
changed_reading.after: The death is already manifest in an opened record; the question performs a public evidentiary challenge to the claim that she supplied any culpable cause.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gestation, birth, a fetus hidden in the womb, and ذنب as ripening from the tail end form a life-course around the feminine killing. This reverses the expected offense-then-penalty timeline: death interrupts maturation before a mature culpable act can plausibly precede it.

activation_trace.role: Ripening that begins from the tail end supplies a developmental image for the life cut off by the focus killing.
Putting to death supplies the interruption that stops the activated gestation-to-ripening sequence.
A she-camel's ten-month gestation supplies the first explicit pregnancy-stage image in the surrounding sequence.
Birth and postpartum blood supply the transition from gestation to a separately living self.
The fetus hidden in the womb supplies the concealed early-life stage that makes premature culpability especially unstable.

structural_cues: The branchless victim noun at 81:8 directly precedes the feminine قتلت and supports a vulnerable early-life referent without supplying any invented branch citation.
The focus asks for a prior ذنب, while the activated life-cycle images point toward development not yet completed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gestation, birth, hidden fetus, tail-end ripening, and killing; I infer an interrupted life-course that makes attribution of mature culpability a temporal category error. A live alternative is that these are remote branch echoes with no shared developmental mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Death appears as punishment following a completed culpable act.
changed_reading.after: Death cuts off a life before its ripening, so the demand for a preceding sin is exposed as temporally incoherent rather than merely unanswered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of an allotted punitive share meets context branches of market price, division into portions, and valuation. The result is a moral ledger in which the question audits not only an individual's act but the regime that priced a life and assigned death as her portion.

activation_trace.role: An allotted share, especially a share of punishment, supplies the ledger entry assigned to the victim.
Literal killing supplies the fatal outcome whose price and apportionment are being audited.
A market price supplies the valuation operation that can rank one life as expendable.
Separating a share and dividing a thing supplies the distributive rule by which punishment is assigned.
Valuation, appraisal, and pricing supply a later counter-standard by which the fatal allocation is reassessed.

structural_cues: The interrogative بأي selects among purported grounds while the indefinite ذنب leaves the alleged ledger entry unnamed.
The passive قتلت presents the assigned outcome without naming who controlled the allocation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies punitive share, market price, apportionment, valuation, and death; I infer a social economy that allocated vulnerability and punishment. Alternatively, the pricing and division branches may remain independent lexical possibilities without a common ledger mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The question concerns the victim's individual offense and a killer's response to it.
changed_reading.after: The question indicts a distributive order that priced the victim, manufactured a punitive share, and allocated death to her.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence supplies a path, an act of remembrance, and upright direction while directly addressing the hearer. The focus question becomes a criterion for where the hearer goes after encountering the victim's case, not a safely enclosed scene about absent perpetrators.

activation_trace.role: The challenged claim of culpability supplies the ethical test carried forward into the hearer's own direction.
The irreversible killing keeps the later orientation question answerable in conduct rather than abstraction.
A path, place, or way supplies the ethical trajectory on which the hearer must locate a response to the killing.
A reminder that makes one remember carries the victim's question beyond its scene into continuing moral attention.
Uprightness, balance, and straightness supply the normative direction against which the hearer's path is measured.

structural_cues: 81:26 shifts into direct plural address with فأين تذهبون.
81:27 universalizes the reminder and 81:28 addresses whoever among you wills to become upright.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, reminder, straightness, and direct second-person address; I infer that 81:9 becomes a remembered criterion for the audience's own orientation. Alternatively, the later address may concern acceptance of the message generally rather than this particular injustice.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts a completed injustice whose agents belong elsewhere or to the past.
changed_reading.after: The verse confronts the present hearer with a directional choice: remembering or repeating the valuation that made the victim killable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus demands culpability despite omitting the human killer, while the ending nests human willing under divine willing and sovereignty. The changed reading preserves responsibility but no longer treats agency as autonomous: exposure, killing, judgment, and the possibility of upright response occupy layered causal levels.

activation_trace.role: Culpable consequence supplies the non-negotiable responsibility claim that any layered account of will must still explain.
Making someone liable to killing supplies a human enabling action within the wider causal order.
Will attached to a thing supplies both the human and divine volitional nodes explicitly repeated in the closing construction.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the encompassing causal level under which human willing operates.

structural_cues: 81:28 attributes willing to whoever among you seeks uprightness, while 81:29 repeats human and divine willing in a nested clause.
81:9 suppresses the killer grammatically but still asks a question of culpability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies linked human and divine wills, sovereignty, culpability, and human exposure of another to death; I infer nested rather than erased agency. A live alternative is that the closing hierarchy of will either weakens human attribution more sharply or intensifies it by locating judgment within sovereignty.

changed_reading.before: The focus can be heard as assigning blame within a wholly autonomous human causal frame.
changed_reading.after: The focus holds human responsibility for making a victim killable inside a larger sovereignty, preserving an unresolved tension between enabled will and culpable action.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the full-bucket sense of ذنوب is vocalically and materially distant from the focus's ordinary culpability sense, and the horizon's bucket branch is equally remote from its surface use. It remains anchored through focus ذنب and is independently activated by abundant water, filling, and a second bucket image. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for a measured or fabricated load of blame, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ذنب at word 2 carries both a punitive-share branch and a full-bucket branch inside the interrogative بأي.

activation_trace.role: A large or nearly full bucket supplies the container whose filled measure becomes an image for accumulated blame.
An allotted share links the bucket's quantity back to punishment assigned in the focus question.
Abundant wide water supplies the material field in which the focus's bucket image can activate.
Filling with water supplies the operation that turns a container into a full measure.
A second root's bucket image independently echoes the focus bucket and keeps the material activation from resting on one branch alone.

changed_reading.before: ذنب denotes an abstract offense alleged against the victim.
changed_reading.after: The alleged offense also appears as a filled and allotted measure loaded onto her, exposing blame as something quantified and assigned rather than discovered.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the male-versus-female branch of ذ ك ر is branch-distant from the surface sense of reminder at 81:27. It remains valid as an echo because the focus killing is explicitly feminine and its ذنب inventory includes socially rear-ranked dependents. Downstream prose should describe a gendered pressure within remembrance, not translate ذكر as male or claim that the branch fixes the verse's meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The feminine قتلت at word 3 and the dependent-tail branch of ذنب at word 2 give the later male/female contrast a precise social anchor.

activation_trace.role: Rear-ranked dependents supply the gendered social hierarchy whose erasure remembrance may resist.
The feminine literal killing supplies the particular life that must not disappear into a generic reminder.
Male as the opposite of female supplies the branch-distant contrast that makes remembrance itself carry a gendered tension.

changed_reading.before: The later reminder preserves a general moral lesson.
changed_reading.after: The reminder can carry a contained gendered echo: it must preserve the particular female life that a rear-ranking social order tried to erase.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because flaying a slaughtered body and the heat of war are material branches attached to cosmic context surfaces. It remains anchored in the focus's literal killing and exposure-to-killing, producing a coherent bodily disclosure mechanism. Downstream prose should render the cosmos as resonating with a crime scene or wound, not identify the sky literally with the victim's body.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The literal and exposure branches of قتلت at word 3 provide the bodily harm to which the later stripping and war-death images return.

activation_trace.role: Putting a life to death supplies the bodily event that gives the cosmic images forensic force.
Flaying skin from a slaughtered animal supplies the visceral image of violent exposure after killing.
The raging of war and death extends the focus harm from one hidden act into a surrounding field of lethal violence.

changed_reading.before: The human killing is a brief moral vignette embedded among unrelated cosmic transformations.
changed_reading.after: The killing becomes an ethical wound through which cosmic uncovering can be felt as the flaying open of concealed violence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because قتل's branch of affected feminine yielding and ج ر ي's girl branch are remote from the focus verb form and the running context surface. It remains anchored by the focus's feminine passive and explicit query about alleged guilt. Downstream prose must use it only to expose how gendered behavior could be fabricated into blame; it must not attribute such behavior to the victim or propose it as the verse's answer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The feminine قتلت at word 3 carries a gender-specific comportment branch while بأي ذنب at word 2 explicitly interrogates the manufacture of culpability.

activation_trace.role: Sin and culpable consequence supply the accusation that a gender norm might falsely manufacture.
A woman or girl yielding coyly in gait or request supplies the gender-coded behavior that a punitive order could miscast as culpability.
A girl or young woman supplies a second gender-specific branch image that activates the comportment branch without becoming a literal identification.

changed_reading.before: The alleged sin is unspecified but otherwise treated as an ordinary possible offense.
changed_reading.after: The question can also expose the prior social act of turning femininity or gender-policed comportment into an offense used to rationalize violence.

strongest_changes: The ask-then-kill passive pair restores the victim from a rear-ranked dependent to the central witness around whom the hearing turns.
Opened records, disclosure, and presence change the question from fact-finding into a public test of an alleged culpable cause.
Tail, exposure, share, price, and division branches widen the focus from a terminal killing to concealed liability and a social allocation of punishment.
Gestation, birth, fetus, and ripening branches create an exploratory interrupted-development reading in which prior culpability becomes temporally incoherent.
The closing path, reminder, uprightness, and nested wills redirect the victim's question toward the hearer's orientation while preserving tension over layered agency.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's split س ء ل mapping activated both overt questioning and covert extraction, while remote but convergent lifecycle, valuation, bucket, and gender branches generated several anchored readings that a conservative synthesis would likely collapse.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant س ء ل to س ل ل activation may be a productive image of concealed removal or merely a mapping-distance artifact.
The ذنب share, full-bucket, tail, and ripening senses are form- or vocalization-distant and should color rather than replace the ordinary culpability reading.
The price, division, and valuation branches may form a coherent social ledger, but they may also remain independent branch resonances.
The closing hierarchy of wills leaves unresolved exactly how human culpability and divine sovereignty interact.
